notes.title: 1.0.5 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Version 1.0.5

- Fixed bug in Chapter 8 where some players may have got stuck and unable to progress the three quests needed to compelte the chapter.
- Fixed bug with player animation glitching in Chapter 5 after a call

As always, if there are any bugs you encounter - please join our discord and post them in our Bug Report tab. Thank you!

notes.title: Updated Release Plan: Steam on July 31, Switch on July 22
notes.notes:
Heya everyone,

We wanted to share a small update. The Steam version of Misc. A Tiny Tale will now be launching just a tiny bit later, on July 31st.


However, we’re still on track for our original launch for Nintendo Switch on July 22nd, so if you’re eager to jump in early, that platform version will be ready to go first!



Misc was originally built around the Nintendo Switch hardware, and we’re so proud of how it runs on that platform. With this short delay, we’re taking a bit of extra time to make sure the PC version feels just as polished and comfortable to play, with high-end performance, better options for PC, and quality-of-life tweaks suited to mouse and keyboard. We’re also using the time to address feedback from early reviewers and fix up some final bugs, so launch day on Steam can be the best experience possible. On top of that, the Steam version will now include a big set of achievements exclusive to this version. We’re working hard to make sure they feel fun and worth the effort for completionists to find!



Thank you for your patience and support. It truly means the world. As a small thank you to our PC players, we’ll be launching Misc. A Tiny Tale on Steam with a 15% discount to celebrate and welcome you into our tiny world!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37749929/89570d6719c08a8482dcb8a30045d5344452352d.png"]

We’re a small team, so a few extra days to polish and get everything sorted will go a very long way, and we’re incredibly thankful for your understanding and support. The game is so close now so please look forward to its release! Thank you for being on this journey with us. We’ll see you then!

notes.title: It's official, we have a RELEASE DATE.
notes.notes:
Hi again! It's been an exciting time!
This week, we announced Misc. A Tiny Tales official release date...

*Drum roll*
The game finally launches: 
🎉 July 22, 2025 for PC & Switch! 🎉

That's less than two months away! To celebrate, we've got an all-new trailer which highlights the key story to expect in the game. Please take a look and let us know what you think. 

[previewyoutube=3y0j45t3aKc;full][/previewyoutube]
It hasn't been easy getting here, but I could not be more proud of how the game's come out and I'm incredibly excited for all of you to finally play it. Every little repost & wishlist makes a huge difference, so if you haven't yet, add it to your wishlist on Steam and share this with a friend or two! Help us get these little robots in the hands of as many people as we can. I truly can't thank you and all the amazing support we've had over these five years to make this game a reality. 

I'm so incredibly eager to get the game into your hands, so please look forward to it!
🔔 If you haven't already, join our community on Discord
🌈 And hop into the fun over at Bluesky! 

Let us know what you think!

notes.title: NEW Trailer and release window! 🎊 Misc. A Tiny Tale
notes.notes:
A Heartwarming 3D Platformer Coming to PC and Nintendo Switch in 2025

Today we're proud to share an all-new trailer for Misc. A Tiny Tale. Our last trailer was way back in 2022, so of course the game's come a long way. Misc is a charming 3D platformer that invites players to embark on a heartwarming journey with two tiny robots, Buddy and Bag Boy. Crafted from everyday objects, these lovable characters work together to make the world a better place—one tiny step at a time.

[previewyoutube=SlRa1fpf_d4;full][/previewyoutube]

We're excited to confirm the game will be releasing in 2025. It's been a long time coming, and getting to the point where a majority of the game is done has been nothing short of a journey. As we wrap things up and prepare for launch, seeing the story unfold and playing through all the games content has been a joy. We couldn't have done it without your support, so please look forward to more soon.

🔔 If you haven't already, join our community on Discord
🌈 And hop into the fun over at Bluesky! 

Let us know what you think!

notes.title: DEVLOG 3 🥳 - HUGE NEWS and release date!
notes.notes:
It's been a wild journey🌱

It is with huge honor that we finally get to announce we're a recipient of Screen Australia's 'Games: Expansion Pack' grant! 🎉 This $150,00 grant will let us do many incredible things with the game. For our lead developer, it means he can focus full-time on the games development.

[previewyoutube=seqRU3tz7_4;full][/previewyoutube]
It's been a long journey getting to this point, and we couldn't be happier with the outcome. There's a lot to go over, so please give our video above a watch! but TLDR:
- Our lead developer will be focusing on the game full time
- We've planned the next two years of development out
- We plan to release the game at the end of this period 🥰

To finally have a release window set out is really special to us. Two years might feel like a long time, but in game development world it's a blip! ✨We can't wait to deliver an incredible experience to you, and make it the best it can be. ✨

A HUGE thank you again to all the amazing folks at Screen Australia for their support. Please check out the full list of games funded here.

When I got the call that we received a grant from Screen Australia, I decided to record my reaction and thoughts in the moment. These moments don't come often in life after all.

[previewyoutube=gtyGSrE0GmY;full][/previewyoutube]
Thank you again to everyone for your support along the way. We can't wait to make this a special experience. 

🔔 If you haven't already, join our community on Discord
📨 Subscribe to our newsletter at the bottom of our website

Let us know what you think.

notes.title: Misc. A Tiny Tale - DEMO UPDATE
notes.notes:
As part of the #SteamNextFest, we've released an all-new demo that features the game's first two chapters. Previously, you could only play an early version of chapter 1. We've also put together a new trailer covering some things we've been working on outside the demo.

[previewyoutube=8_yVRukOfoc;full][/previewyoutube]
Demo Update Patch Notes: 

 Chapter 2 has been added and is now playable
 The UI has had an overhaul, with cogs collected now being displayed in a meter.
 Controls are now displayed on-screen as you play.
 A loading screen/animation has been added.
 Character physics and overall control has been adjusted.
 Visuals overall have been improved for performance.
 Fixed a major bug on low-end computers which should increase performance.
 All cutscenes now run at 60fps with revamped visuals.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37749929/50bd76fc409448f6a9d8cfdb48fcf4fbe2cced27.png
As stated in the patch notes, we've spent some time updating the UI to include a cog meter that counts up. I hope this meter helps people visualize their progress in the level.

In chapter 2, you'll find yourself in the vibrant 'Chirping Woods'. Clean gunk around the level with your new brush tool, help quirky robots around you and discover the mystery behind the robotic inventor Atom. 🤖

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37749929/350f64c0975b0f461263d1aebddcb3ec90c08d3b.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37749929/08f38b887cfc95fe09bf4fefa622a208de7da12b.png

We hope you enjoy playing through chapter 2 and exploring the many improvements we've made to the overall game. Don't forget to stream the game on platforms such as Twitch! We have a 'Misc. A Tiny Tale' game tag set up so we can easily find your stream of the game and join in on the fun too.

🔔 If you haven't already, join our community on Discord
📨 Subscribe to our newsletter at the bottom of our website

We'll continue to work hard every day on the full version of the game. Stay tuned for more news.

Happy Steam Next Fest!
